messages.author: df74d6fccec2ff7e
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] error with function backTransform
parts:
Hi Manuel,

If you have covariates in your model, you need to use linearComb first. See ?linearComb. Something like this should work to get an estimate of psi when bosq has a value of 2:

lc <- linearComb(mod2, c(1, 2), type="state") # Intercept=1, bosq=2
backTransform(lc)

Or you could use predict.

newdata <- data.frame(bosq=seq(-2, 2, length=50)) # if bosq ranges from -2 to 2
predict(mod2, type="state", newdata=newdata)


Richard
